THIRDhub

SIx-part platform combined of Situational-awareness, IR readiness, Threat-hunting+Deception, Investigation, Response, Automated IR Report – for comprehensive cloud operations oversight.

Cloud Investigation and Response Automation (CIRA)

CIRA streamlines the process of investigating and responding to cloud threats across various cloud environments. It integrates with both cloud-native telemetry and other security mechanisms to automatically handle threats, enhancing both the speed and efficiency of security responses.

Cloud Threat Hunting and Response (CDR)

This proactive approach involves continuously searching for and identifying malicious actors within your cloud infrastructure. CDR operates autonomously, using advanced techniques to detect threats that may be attempting to establish a presence undetected within your environment.

Enhanced Threat Detection Incident Response (TDIR)

Powered by AI, Cyngular’s TDIR solution enhances threat detection with advanced behavioral models and deception technology. By integrating behavioral threat detection with traditional indicators, we map attacks based on unique patterns of emerging threats. Our use of decoy assets lures attackers, providing critical insights that improve detection. With this powerful combination, we turn tactical IOCs into actionable intelligence, offering proactive protection against sophisticated attacks.

Build to empower, not replace, your current cloud security stack

A multi-cloud environment platform that seamlessly integrates with your existing security measures, enhancing security operations posture to ensure comprehensive protection and efficiency in securing your cloud ecosystem.

Simple, Safe, Fast Installation

Deploy in minutes and gain immediate, critical insights

Unified Multi-Cloud Management

THIRDhub platform offers a comprehensive “single pane of glass” view designed to simplify the management of multi-cloud environments. This feature is especially beneficial for Multi-Cloud environments, providing an efficient and streamlined way to oversee various cloud services from a single interface. With our solution, SOC teams can easily monitor, manage, and secure their cloud operations, enhancing visibility and control across all cloud platforms without the complexity of managing multiple cloud environments.

Redefining Identity investigation with advanced capabilities

THIRDhub by Cyngular safeguards both human and non-human identities, providing unparalleled protection in the cloud. Our platform enables proactive threat hunting and facilitates rapid investigations centered on identities and other cloud resources, ensuring that every access point is secure. With THIRDhub, identity security becomes the cornerstone of robust threat detection and response.
